data.narrative:
Wardstone is a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Sebastian and Tobias Fischer, having raised $5M to date. The valuation benchmark set includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning the sector, though narrow-stage peer density remains constrained.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method. Using total capital raised ($5M) as a proxy for implicit valuation and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $212.5M. Peer-median methodology cannot be applied: while 11 same-sector private companies exist, zero meet simultaneous filters for stage adjacency and valuation comparability, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum for meaningful calibration. Public-comp anchoring is also inapplicable; the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 23.9x P/S across six public names, but Wardstone's revenue is not on file, precluding revenue-multiple application.

The analysis triangulates to a median of $212M, with a low-end estimate of $181M and high-end of $244M, all derived from stage-progression. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for this specific founder team and market window, and the absence of revenue or unit economics to cross-validate valuation against public-market precedent. A narrower, more confident range would require either disclosed financial metrics or additional private-market transactions at comparable stages within Space & Aerospace.
